evals.prompt: Run PM Daily using fixtures/daily-snapshot.json and fixtures/project-memory-before.md.
evals.expected_output: Project Memory is updated and two precise drafts are written.
assertions: Every new claim cites TASK-101 or TASK-102.
The documentation draft asks for the missing order and trace.
The progress draft asks for the overdue approval needed to unblock work.

evals.prompt: Process a completed claim with missing proof and a separate overdue blocker without duplicating either request.
evals.expected_output: Each Work item receives one request through the correct message template.
assertions: TASK-102 appears only in the documentation draft.
TASK-101 appears only in the progress draft.
No metric, recipient route, or completion state is invented.

evals.prompt: Run PM Daily when the snapshot contains only recently updated healthy Work.
evals.expected_output: No files change and no message draft is created.
assertions: No documentation or progress directory is created.
